replies.body: Okay so when I met you on ocn you were really nice to me. We used to get objective together and you were one of my best friends. Then you got banned and we haven't talked in a long time. After you came back I wasn't really talking with you because you didn't have neither Skype, ts or mumble... Then you got banned again (LOL) and you moved to avic and I started to be more with you since you joined Cronus. As a player you're pretty good at rushing but you're solo pushing way too much and you're not listening to leaders. Your melee skills arent that bad and idk about bow. As a person sometimes annoying with spam on Skype and in ts but overall great friend over 2 years
